integrity.computational_check: A standalone SymPy checker verifies the symbolic determinant and all sixteen witnesses; it is corroboration rather than proof by exhaustion.

limitations: The two exact-support profiles are specific to the finite quaternion group of order eight.
The rank-weighted Fourier support is not the number of nonzero irreducible blocks and is not a positional support-incidence census.
All optimizing functions are not classified up to group automorphisms and scaling.
An equivalent result buried in non-indexed historical group-ring material cannot be ruled out by available searches.
title: Exact real and complex rank-weighted Fourier uncertainty on \(Q_8\)
